prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Medium shot. Silhouettes with drums and raised cups dance around a fire in a camp of tents, the vast ark, its whole hull smeared pitch-black under a flat plank roof, dark on the hill behind them against the night sky. Night, torchlight and smoke. Merry and blind. The ark is one long, low, box-shaped wooden hull with straight sides of rough planks and flat square ends, the same low height from end to end. The ark has no mast, sail, prow, figurehead, funnel or smokestack, no smoke rising from it and no band along its waterline. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the great wooden ark, the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
